lead_raw_text:
The trigonal crystal Tb3Ti6O18 (reduced formula TbTi2O6) adopts the trigonal R-3m space group (No. 166), with 27 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ti centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Tb centers display a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Ti octahedra share edges with one another, and face-sharing is observed between Tb 12-vertex coordination polyhedra and Ti octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
